description: This file defines the SpotsDashlet class, a custom dashlet for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including methods for displaying, configuring, and managing spots within the dashlet.

classes.name: SpotsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying and configuring 'Spots' in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loads language strings, and sets configuration options.

methods.name: checkIfSpotHasBeenDeleted
methods.description: Checks if a spot with the given ID has been deleted.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML to display the dashlet, including spot data if available.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML for the dashlet configuration form.

methods.name: getSpotsList
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded list of available spots with their details.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and filters user-submitted configuration options.
